question: Among all products sold in the United States with promo_id=999, considering only those cities whose sales increased by at least 20% from Q4 2019 (calendar_quarter_id=1772) to Q4 2020 (calendar_quarter_id=1776), which product that ranks in the top 20% of total sales has the smallest percentage-point change in its share of total sales between these two quarters?

WITH q1772 AS (
  SELECT c.cust_city, SUM(s.amount_sold) as total_sales
  FROM sales s
  JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
  JOIN countries co ON c.country_id = co.country_id
  JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
  WHERE s.promo_id = 999
    AND co.country_name = 'United States of America'
    AND t.calendar_quarter_id = 1772
  GROUP BY c.cust_city
),
q1776 AS (
  SELECT c.cust_city, SUM(s.amount_sold) as total_sales
  FROM sales s
  JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
  JOIN countries co ON c.country_id = co.country_id
  JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
  WHERE s.promo_id = 999
    AND co.country_name = 'United States of America'
    AND t.calendar_quarter_id = 1776
  GROUP BY c.cust_city
),
qualifying_cities AS (
  SELECT q1772.cust_city
  FROM q1772
  JOIN q1776 ON q1772.cust_city = q1776.cust_city
  WHERE q1772.total_sales > 0
    AND 1.0 * (q1776.total_sales - q1772.total_sales) / q1772.total_sales >= 0.20
),
product_sales_2019 AS (
  SELECT s.prod_id, SUM(s.amount_sold) as prod_sales
  FROM sales s
  JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
  JOIN countries co ON c.country_id = co.country_id
  JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
  WHERE s.promo_id = 999
    AND co.country_name = 'United States of America'
    AND t.calendar_quarter_id = 1772
    AND c.cust_city IN (SELECT cust_city FROM qualifying_cities)
  GROUP BY s.prod_id
),
product_sales_2020 AS (
  SELECT s.prod_id, SUM(s.amount_sold) as prod_sales
  FROM sales s
  JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
  JOIN countries co ON c.country_id = co.country_id
  JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
  WHERE s.promo_id = 999
    AND co.country_name = 'United States of America'
    AND t.calendar_quarter_id = 1776
    AND c.cust_city IN (SELECT cust_city FROM qualifying_cities)
  GROUP BY s.prod_id
),
product_combined AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(p1.prod_id, p2.prod_id) as prod_id,
         COALESCE(p1.prod_sales, 0) as sales_2019,
         COALESCE(p2.prod_sales, 0) as sales_2020,
         COALESCE(p1.prod_sales, 0) + COALESCE(p2.prod_sales, 0) as total_sales
  FROM product_sales_2019 p1
  FULL OUTER JOIN product_sales_2020 p2 ON p1.prod_id = p2.prod_id
),
product_with_rank AS (
  SELECT prod_id, total_sales,
         NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) as tile
  FROM product_combined
),
top_20_pct AS (
  SELECT prod_id FROM product_with_rank WHERE tile = 1
)
SELECT t.prod_id
FROM top_20_pct t
JOIN products p ON t.prod_id = p.prod_id
LEFT JOIN product_sales_2019 ps2019 ON t.prod_id = ps2019.prod_id
LEFT JOIN product_sales_2020 ps2020 ON t.prod_id = ps2020.prod_id
ORDER BY t.prod_id
